election.note: Plural: hilbijartin(ên). Verbal noun of hilbijartin (to choose).

general election.note: Plural 'hilbijartinên giştî' is the usual press form. In Turkey, 'hilbijartinên giştî' often means parliamentary elections.

primary.note: Also 'pêşhilbijartin'. US usage; often glossed as 'hilbijartina berendamtiya partiyê'.

by-election.note: Also 'hilbijartina tijîkirina kursiya valayî'. Turkish 'ara seçim' is the model.

special election.note: Press often explains it as 'hilbijartina li derveyî demsala asayî'.

recall election.note: Descriptive rendering of the US recall. Alternative: 'dengdana ji wezîfeyê rakirinê'.

contest.note: Also 'pêşbirka hilbijartinê'. One race for one office.

race.note: Same word as 'contest'. Informal register, 'pêşbaziya kursiyê'.

ballot measure.note: Descriptive. Press may also say 'pêşniyara li ber dengdanê'.

referendum.note: Also spelled 'referandûm'. 'Raya giştî' is a rarer alternative.

initiative.note: A citizen-petition measure. Press also uses 'înîsiyatîf'.

proposition.note: For numbered US measures, 'Pêşniyara 8' or 'Proposition 8'. Often left as 'Proposition' with a gloss.

retention election.note: No established equivalent; descriptive rendering ('vote on keeping the judge'). Press often keeps 'retention election' in parentheses.

candidate.note: Also 'namzed' in some press. 'Berendam' is the standard form.

incumbent.note: Also 'serokê heyî' for presidents or mayors. 'Yê ku li ser kar e' is a descriptive alternative.

nominee.note: Short for the candidate officially chosen by the party.

write-in.note: Descriptive. Refers to a name written onto the ballot, a US practice.

unopposed.note: Used as in 'bê hevrik hate hilbijartin'. 'Hevrik' means rival.

ballot.note: 'Pusula dengdanê' in full. Alternative: 'kaxeza dengdanê'. The word comes via Turkish 'pusula'.

valid votes.note: Plural. Turkish 'geçerli oy' is the model.

invalid votes.note: Plural. Turkish 'geçersiz oy' is the model.

blank votes.note: Plural. Turkish 'boş oy' is the model.

registered voters.note: Plural. 'Dengdêr' is a variant of 'hilbijêr'. The electoral roll is 'lîsteya hilbijêran'.

vote share.note: Full: 'rêjeya dengên ku stendine'. Ezafe: 'rêjeya dengên partiyê'.

margin.note: The gap between winner and runner-up. Also 'ferqa dengan'.

swing.note: Descriptive. 'Swing' is sometimes kept in press analysis.

majority.note: For more than half. Plain 'piranî' means 'most/majority' in general.

landslide.note: Descriptive. Also 'serkeftina ji ber cudahiyeke mezin'.

district.note: An electoral or administrative district. US congressional district: 'herêma kongreyê'. Never 'çember'.

ward.note: Ward as a city subdivision. Equivalent to Turkish 'mahalle'. Alternative: 'dorpêç'.

precinct.note: Descriptive for the US voting precinct. Press may keep 'precinct' in parentheses.

polling station.note: Also 'cihê dengdanê'. 'Sindoq' means the ballot box.

reporting unit.note: Technical term. Means any area whose results are published.

county.note: Used for US, UK, and Irish counties, like Turkish 'ilçe'. Never 'kontî'.

municipality.note: Means both the municipality and its administration.

state.note: For US states and Brazilian states. German Land: 'eyalet' or 'Land'. 'Wîlayet' is also used.

province.note: Used for provinces and for Turkish il. Ezafe: 'parêzgeha'.

polity.note: Descriptive. Means a country, state or territory with its own elections. Alternative: 'dewlet an herêma xwedî hilbijartin'.

redistricting.note: Descriptive: 'ji nû ve xêzkirina sînorên çemberên hilbijartinê'.

parliament.note: Turkey's national parliament: 'Meclîsa Tirkiyeyê ya Mezin'.

senate.note: Loan form used in Kurdish press.

house of representatives.note: For the US House: 'Meclîsa Nûneran a Amerîkayê'.

council.note: Local councils: 'meclîsa şaredariyê' is also used. 'Konsey' is a variant.

governor.note: Used for US governors. 'Walî' is used for the Turkish appointed vali.

alliance.note: Electoral alliances, as with the Turkish 'ittifak'. Also 'ittifaq'.

open list.note: Voters can reorder via preference votes.

leveling seat.note: Descriptive. For adjustment or compensatory seats.

threshold.note: Short for 'bendava hilbijartinê', the electoral threshold. Turkish 'seçim barajı' is the model.

quota.note: Loan word. 'Kotaya Droop' for the Droop quota.

first past the post.note: Descriptive. Press may cite 'first past the post' in parentheses.

ranked-choice voting.note: Descriptive. The US 'ranked-choice voting' is often kept in parentheses.

D'Hondt method.note: Name is kept in the original form.

Sainte-Laguë method.note: Name is kept in the original form.

count.note: A round in STV/IRV. The general act of counting is 'jimartin'.

called.note: Predicate form: 'serkeftî hat ragihandin'. Means a race declared for a winner.

reporting.note: Modeled on Turkish 'açılan sandık oranı'. Share of units counted.

gain.note: Descriptive. A seat won from another party.

hold.note: Descriptive. A party keeping its seat.

gerrymander.note: Usually kept as a loan word and glossed: 'dabeşkirina çemberan a alîgir'.

electoral college.note: Press rendering for the US body. Sometimes 'Koleja Hilbijêran'.

changeset.note: Technical. A reviewed batch of edits.

provenance.note: Descriptive. Means where data came from and how it was processed.

coverage.note: Technical. Means how much of the elections the archive holds. Alternative: 'berfirehiya daneyan'.

bounty.note: Descriptive. A requested data task with a reward.

workbench.note: Descriptive for the site's tool for tables and charts.

Elections Archive.note: The product name; never translate it.
